summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable standalone TikZ (version 1, compiled and validated). It shows a semicircle with diameter MN and center O, a vertical radius OP, point A on OP, and point B on the arc, joined to O and A. All six labels (P, B, A, O, M, N) were bound by CV and confirmed in the critic's labels check. The critic scored it 0.92 with must_repair=false. Its only note is a low-severity one: filled dots appear at M, N and P, which the original does not show.
